description: 20 real-world test scenarios covering wechat_article_css_dl and wechat_article_push_dl

tests.scenario: 技术博客 — 含<style>块、渐变色、flex布局
tests.prompt: I exported a tech blog post as HTML from Notion. The CSS has a style block with dark theme gradients and flexbox cards. Before I push this to WeChat, check if it's compatible. File: /tmp/notion-tech-blog.html
tests.html_content:
How AI Works

Deep learning explained simply.

tests.scenario: 电商产品页 — CSS变量 + grid布局
tests.prompt: Our product team sent me an HTML product page with CSS grid and custom properties for the brand colors. Need to make it WeChat-compatible. File: /tmp/product-page.html

tests.scenario: 邮件通讯稿 — 含@media响应式查询
tests.prompt: This is a newsletter HTML from Mailchimp export. It has responsive media queries for mobile. I want to publish it on WeChat but worried about the @media rules. File: /tmp/newsletter.html

tests.scenario: 纯内联样式文章 — 已兼容，应报告clean
tests.prompt: I wrote an article with only inline styles — no style blocks, no fancy CSS. Just colors, fonts, and spacing. Check if it's WeChat-ready. File: /tmp/clean-article.html
tests.html_content:
Hello World

This article uses only inline styles and is fully WeChat compatible.

tests.scenario: 列表文章 — ::before做自定义bullet
tests.prompt: This article uses ::before pseudo-elements for custom bullet points in lists. Will WeChat render them? File: /tmp/bullet-list.html

tests.scenario: 卡片设计 — box-shadow + hover效果
tests.prompt: We have cards with hover effects and box-shadows in our article. Need to check WeChat compatibility. File: /tmp/cards-hover.html

tests.scenario: 渐变文字标题 — -webkit-background-clip
tests.prompt: My article title uses gradient text with -webkit-background-clip. Will WeChat show the gradient? File: /tmp/gradient-title.html

tests.scenario: 步骤列表 — CSS counter自动编号
tests.prompt: I have a numbered step-by-step guide using CSS counters. Need to check if it works in WeChat. File: /tmp/steps-counter.html

tests.scenario: 动画内容 — opacity过度+动画
tests.prompt: This article has fade-in animations using opacity and CSS transitions. Will they work in WeChat's reader? File: /tmp/animated.html

tests.scenario: 复杂混合页面 — 所有违规模板
tests.prompt: This HTML has everything: style block, CSS variables, gradients, flex, grid, ::before, counters, @media, box-shadow, and hover effects. Check all violations at once. File: /tmp/all-violations.html

tests.scenario: 标准HTML推文 — 全部参数齐全
tests.prompt: Push this HTML article to WeChat: file is /tmp/tech-article.html, title is 'Understanding Transformers', style tech, author 'dennon', cover https://picsum.photos/1200/800, enable comments.

tests.scenario: Markdown→小绿书 — 图片帖子
tests.prompt: Publish this markdown as a 小绿书 image post: /tmp/travel-diary.md, cover https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1, no title needed (it's in frontmatter).

tests.scenario: 缺少封面图 — 错误处理
tests.prompt: I want to push this HTML article but I don't have a cover image. File: /tmp/no-cover.html, title: 'My Article'.

tests.scenario: IP白名单错误 — 错误处理
tests.prompt: I tried pushing but got error 40164 saying my IP is not whitelisted. My WeChat backend is at mp.weixin.qq.com. What do I do?

tests.scenario: 粉丝评论 + 节日风格
tests.prompt: Push this markdown to WeChat with festival style, enable comments but only fans can comment. File: /tmp/lunar-new-year.md, cover https://example.com/red-envelope.jpg, author '小红'.

tests.scenario: 学术灰风格 — 标准新闻稿
tests.prompt: Push this academic paper summary to WeChat. Markdown at /tmp/paper-summary.md, title 'Attention Is All You Need: A Summary', style academic_gray, author 'Research Team', cover https://example.com/paper-cover.jpg.

user_input.title: Attention Is All You Need: A Summary
user_input.author: Research Team

tests.scenario: 自定义摘要 + 公告风格
tests.prompt: Push an urgent announcement to WeChat. HTML at /tmp/urgent-announcement.html, title 'System Maintenance Tonight', style announcement, summary 'Important: downtime from 2-4 AM', author 'IT Team', cover https://example.com/warning.jpg.

tests.scenario: 直接传内容串 — 不用文件
tests.prompt:
Push this short HTML directly: content is '

Hello WeChat

', title 'Quick Post', cover https://example.com/quick.jpg, no author.

tests.scenario: 长文章 — 内容超过限制
tests.prompt: I'm getting error 45004 when trying to push my article. It's a very long guide with lots of sections. File: /tmp/long-guide.md, title 'Complete Guide', cover https://example.com/guide.jpg. What's wrong?

tests.scenario: 认证号检查 — 404错误
tests.prompt: I tried pushing to WeChat but got a 404 error. My account is a basic subscription account, not verified. File: /tmp/article.html, title 'Test'.
